title: drynaria latipinna
intro: Drynaria latipinna, commonly known as Chinese Tuckahoe or Plateau Tuckahoe, is a type of fern that belongs to the family Polypodiaceae. It has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties. The therapeutic actions of Drynaria latipinna include reducing swelling and pain, improving immune function, and enhancing cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents of this plant include polysaccharides, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
